identification_accuracy.name: Identification Accuracy
identification_accuracy.description: Evaluates whether the participant correctly identifies the content as real or AI-generated.

scores.3: Correctly identifies the content and clearly states their answer.
scores.2: Leans toward the correct answer but expresses uncertainty.
scores.1: Gives an unclear answer or leans toward the incorrect answer.

quality_of_reasoning.name: Quality of Reasoning
quality_of_reasoning.description: Evaluates how well the participant explains their decision.

scores.3: Provides a clear explanation supported by multiple relevant observations or pieces of evidence.
scores.2: Gives at least one relevant reason but does not explain it in much detail.
scores.1: Gives a vague explanation without identifying specific reasons.
scores.0: Provides no explanation or reasoning unrelated to the content.

visual_audio_clues.name: Understanding of Visual and Audio Clues
visual_audio_clues.description: Evaluates recognition of details that could indicate manipulated or AI-generated content.

scores.3: Identifies relevant visual or audio clues, explains why they matter, and recognizes that these clues are not definitive proof.
scores.2: Identifies a relevant clue but does not fully explain its significance or limitations.
scores.1: Mentions a vague or unreliable clue without explaining how it relates to manipulation.
scores.0: Does not identify relevant clues or relies entirely on unsupported assumptions.

verification_strategies.name: Verification Strategies
verification_strategies.description: Evaluates whether the participant understands how to verify the authenticity of online media.

scores.3: Suggests multiple practical verification strategies, including checking the original source or comparing independent reliable sources.
scores.2: Suggests at least one useful verification method and explains how it could help.
scores.1: Mentions verifying the content without explaining how.
scores.0: Does not suggest verification methods or relies entirely on an AI detector as definitive proof.

critical_thinking_uncertainty.name: Critical Thinking and Uncertainty
critical_thinking_uncertainty.description: Evaluates consideration of context, uncertainty, and limitations of personal judgment.

scores.3: Considers context, acknowledges uncertainty when appropriate, and avoids unsupported assumptions.
scores.2: Shows some awareness of uncertainty or context but does not fully explain its importance.
scores.1: Makes a conclusion with limited consideration of alternative explanations or available evidence.
scores.0: Makes an unsupported, overly confident claim or bases judgment entirely on personal beliefs.
